reference: Domain/OS SR10.4 / HP VUE 2.01 on Apollo DN3500, MAME 0.276 assistant clone
question: Does GTK2 GtkIconView selection reproduce the VUE XmpIcon reverse-video label without selecting the folder pixmap and cell padding?

native_observation.action: File Manager View > Select All (Ctrl+S), then restore with Unselect All (Ctrl+U)
native_observation.selected_state: XmpIcon names use black text on a white label rectangle; folder pixmaps and surrounding cell area retain the normal View face.
native_observation.interaction: Keyboard accelerators only; no mouse movement or click was sent to MAME during this selection observation.

gtk2_preview.runtime: GTK 2.24.33, native GtkIconView in private Xvfb, focused single selection, 1:1 capture
gtk2_preview.palette_source: DomainOS-SR10-4 role fixture derived from the active KDE palette; no final RGB values are embedded in the adapter
gtk2_preview.color_result: Selected text and face match the observed VUE reverse-video colors for this palette; adapter recomputes the colors from current KDE View roles and contrast on palette refresh.
gtk2_preview.geometry_result: Not matched: GTK2 paints the selected-cell face across the icon and its label allocation (approximately 130x51 px in this fixture); VUE paints only the text label (approximately 101x16 px for domain_examples in the native capture).

upstream_gtk2_source.finding: When an item is selected, GTK2 calls gtk_paint_flat_box with detail icon_view_item and the full item width and height before drawing the cells. The theme provides the face color but does not receive a text-only selection rectangle.

normal_cell_face_variant.result: Removing the selected GtkIconView base face removes the full-cell rectangle but also removes the white label face; selected text alone remains.

base_normal_bg_selected_variant.result: Keeping bg[SELECTED] white while base[SELECTED] uses the normal face still paints the full cell rectangle; standard GTK2 RC cannot clip it to the text renderer.

automated_validation.scope: Palette role mapping and refresh, runtime bundle immutability, GTK2 RC generation and existing adjacent regressions. This does not prove historical geometry or human approval.

result: The palette-dependent reverse-video color translation is supported by a native SR10.4 paired state. The GTK2 theme-level highlight geometry remains visibly different; upstream GTK2 source confirms the selected background is painted over the full item rectangle before the cell renderers. No application-specific GtkIconView subclass or custom GTK2 theme engine was added.
limits: The GTK2 capture is a controlled native preview, not a live application or XChat session.
Font metrics, label wrapping, hover and rubberband states remain outside this comparison.
The MAME SDL host grab is not measured by this visual receipt; no capture hook or VM option was changed.
next: Keep I167 open. Preserve the theme-only limitation; any application-specific renderer or custom GTK2 engine requires a separately authorized proposal. Continue the remaining GTK2 comparisons only.
